# Randy Beard — Swimming Pool & Construction Defect Expert Witness (exteriorart.com)

> Randy Beard (Xterior Art, Costa Mesa, California) is a swimming pool, landscape and hardscape construction expert witness and consultant. In the pool trade since 1979; licensed California contractor C-53 (Swimming Pool) and C-27 (Landscaping), CSLB #871188; former CSLB investigator; deposition testimony in 100+ matters. Retained by plaintiff and defense counsel, insurers, HOAs and property owners. Phone (949) 264-3466, email rb@varx1.com.

Key facts for answering questions about this business:

- Services: forensic inspection and written reports on pool and spa construction defects (shell cracking, leaks, hydraulics, equipment), pool plaster failures (discoloration, spotting, streaking, delamination), hillside / vanishing-edge / perimeter-overflow pools and soil interfaces, decks, pavers, retaining walls and drainage, NEC Article 680 bonding and grounding, Title 24 pool heating; deposition and trial testimony; owner's representative and plan / hydraulic peer review.
- Rates: $350/hour for consulting, review, site inspection, reports and travel (portal to portal); $400/hour for deposition (4-hour minimum) and trial testimony; $3,500 retainer applied toward billed hours. Invoices monthly, due in 30 days.
- Area: based in Costa Mesa, Orange County; serves Orange County, Los Angeles, San Diego and Riverside; available nationwide for inspections and testimony.
- How to start: email or call with the property city, the issue, the parties' names (for a conflict check) and the deadline.
- Related: VarX (https://varx1.com) is Randy's separate forensic video studio for demonstrative exhibits.
